preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'val') and isinstance(root.val, int) and (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'val') and isinstance(root.left.val, int))) and (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'val') and isinstance(root.right.val, int)))
preconditions.description: root is either None or a valid binary tree node with integer value and optional left/right children that are also valid nodes.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer in the range [0, 10^9 + 6].

postconditions.expression: return_value == (sum(1 for path in all_downward_paths(root) if sum(path) == K)) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of all downward paths in the tree whose node values sum to K, modulo 10^9 + 7. A downward path is a sequence of nodes starting at any node and proceeding strictly downwards to any descendant (including the node itself).
